newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver recovers by close, gold falls.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver recovers by close, gold falls.

text.p: Silver prices opened weak on Monday following a subdued world trend but limited arrivals and a shortage of ready metal helped them recover towards close, dealers said.
Silver was up 65 rupees per kg on Saturday.
Industrial buying was poor in early trade but picked up by close on enquiries from India's northern region, dealers said.
Gold opened firm but ended weak on light profit-taking as the world market continued to remain subdued.
Gold biscuits (116.50 grammes each) settled 100 rupees lower at 56,100 rupees per piece. They were up 100 rupees on Saturday but lost 500 rupees over the previous week.
